capabilities: Apply Typora-style typography, metrics, and code palette to reading view
Switch responsive reading widths and fixed or full-width modes
Follow dark themes with a Typora night-inspired palette
Opt into a qs-home dashboard layout via cssclasses
Toggle paragraph indent, code font, and high contrast in settings
disambiguation: Not a text formatter or Markdown rewriter; it only changes reading-view and Live Preview styling via CSS.
extras: Settings UI is in Chinese though behavior is language-independent. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.5.0+. The qs-home dashboard layout is reading-view only by design and does not appear in Live Preview. README states the plugin reads no note content and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's default reading typography differs from Typora's layout, and recreating it requires hand-written CSS snippets.

relations.evidence: [TOC] & TOC Reader compatible: clean list styling without bullet collisions

summary: Theme plugin that applies Typora-style reading typography to Obsidian, with responsive widths, dark mode palettes, callout colors, and optional toggles.
